assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Side view of a cone with its apex at the top, base radius r and height h, cut into five slices of thickness h/n; each slice shows its outer cylinder as a dashed blue rectangle and its inner cylinder as a shaded orange rectangle.

difficulty_rationale: The slicing idea is not given, and the proof needs inner and outer cylinders, the sum of squares and a squeeze argument.
